blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A petition for the extradition to the United States of alleged sex offender and religious sect founder Apollo Quiboloy will soon be filed before a local court, said Justice Secretary Fredderick Vida on Thursday. Vida said this as a review of the US request was almost done. “We’re in the final stages already of the vetting. We’re just doing some legal scrubbing. We’re almost ready to file the petition,” Vida said on Thursday at a press briefing at the Department of Justice (DOJ) headquarters.
